parameters.formDescription: Please fill out your details and upload your resume PDF to apply.

values.fieldLabel: How did you hear about us?

parameters.jsCode:
// Extract form data and construct standardized candidate object
const form = $input.first().json;
const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
const randomId = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
const candidateId = `CAND_${Date.now()}_${randomId}`;

// Binary resume file reference
// FIX BUG 4: Normalize the binary key to 'resume' so downstream Extract PDF node finds it reliably
const rawBinary = $input.first().binary || {};
const firstBinaryKey = Object.keys(rawBinary)[0];
const binaryData = firstBinaryKey ? { resume: rawBinary[firstBinaryKey] } : {};

const candidate = {
  candidate_id: candidateId,
  job_id: form["Job ID (e.g. JOB_2026_001)"] || "JOB_2026_001",
  // FIX BUG 2: Map 'Position Applied For' to the 'position' field used by all email templates
  position: form["Position Applied For"] || "",
  full_name: form["Full Name"],
  email: (form["Email Address"] || "").trim().toLowerCase(),
  phone: form["Phone Number"] || "",
  linkedin_url: form["LinkedIn Profile URL"] || "",
  portfolio_url: form["Portfolio / GitHub URL"] || "",
  source: form["How did you hear about us?"] || "Career Site",
  referral_by: form["Referral Name (if any)"] || "",
  application_date: timestamp,
  status: "new",
  stage: "applied",
  overall_score: 0,
  tier: "PENDING",
  skills_score: 0,
  experience_score: 0,
  education_score: 0,
  salary_score: 0,
  culture_fit_score: 0,
  red_flags: "[]",
  rejection_reason: "",
  current_title: "",
  current_company: "",
  years_experience: Number(form["Years of Total Experience"] || 0),
  technical_skills: "",
  education: "",
  certifications: "",
  current_salary: form["Current Salary"] || "",
  expected_salary: form["Expected Salary"] || "",
  notice_period: form["Notice Period"] || "",
  available_date: form["Available Start Date"] || "",
  resume_file_url: "",
  cover_letter: form["Cover Letter / Note"] || "",
  interview_1_date: "",
  interview_1_score: "",
  interview_1_feedback: "",
  interview_2_date: "",
  interview_2_score: "",
  interview_2_feedback: "",
  offer_amount: "",
  offer_sent_date: "",
  offer_status: "",
  hire_date: "",
  rejection_date: "",
  notes: "Form application submitted",
  last_updated: timestamp
};

return [{
  json: candidate,
  binary: binaryData
}];
